target.statement: HyperSeg achieves 84.8 cIoU on RefCOCO val (referring expression segmentation).

compute.basis: Training HyperSeg requires 8 A100 GPUs for 160k iterations on multiple datasets; even inference on a single image needs a GPU with enough VRAM to load the 2.7B LLM and segmentation model, which is not feasible on a CPU-only laptop.

blockers: No code or model weights released (paper says 'will be publicly released')
Requires 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs for training
Requires large-scale multi-dataset training (COCO Panoptic, RefCOCO series, ReasonSeg, DAVIS, etc.)
Inference requires GPU with substantial VRAM (likely >16GB) to load Phi-2 2.7B and segmentation modules
title: HyperSeg: Towards Universal Visual Segmentation with Large Language Model
